fusions.name: Seeded Cannon
fusions.desc: Launches a seed that takes root, dealing 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaving it [Caged] for 6 seconds. Against a boss or elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Crowding Growth
fusions.desc: Sprouts fronds around you, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, each with a 40% chance to be [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sown Shallows
fusions.desc: Sows a thriving bed where you stand. For 12 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles of it. Every ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 10% stronger, up to 4.

fusions.name: Rootbound
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 16. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
